Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

The present disclosure relates to an imaging apparatus and an information processing system capable of decreasing the amount of data of a video or the like transmitted through a network and suppressing power consumption of the imaging apparatus. An imaging apparatus which is a first aspect of the present disclosure includes: an image sensor that includes an imaging surface in which many pixels are arranged vertically and horizontally; a pixel control unit that controls the image sensor, selects a pixel corresponding to a sampling function among pixels configuring a block by applying the sampling function for each block acquired by partitioning the imaging surface of the image sensor into a plurality of blocks, and outputs a sampling signal based on a pixel value of the selected pixel; and a reduced image generating unit that generates a reduced image on the basis of the sampling signal for each block output from the image sensor.

outputs.L1: The present disclosure relates to an imaging apparatus and an information processing system capable of reducing the volume of video or other data transmitted over a network while suppressing power consumption by the imaging apparatus. According to a first aspect of the present disclosure, an imaging apparatus includes: an image sensor having an imaging surface on which a plurality of pixels are arranged vertically and horizontally; a pixel control unit configured to control the image sensor, apply a sampling function to each block obtained by partitioning the imaging surface of the image sensor into a plurality of blocks, select, from among the pixels constituting each block, a pixel corresponding to the sampling function, and output a sampling signal based on a pixel value of the selected pixel; and a reduced-image generation unit configured to generate a reduced image based on the sampling signal output from the image sensor for each block.
outputs.L2: This disclosure concerns an imaging device and an information processing system designed to reduce the volume of video or similar data sent over a network while limiting the imaging device’s power consumption. In a first aspect of the disclosure, the imaging device includes an image sensor having an imaging surface with numerous pixels arranged in vertical and horizontal directions. A pixel control unit operates the image sensor by dividing its imaging surface into multiple blocks, applying a sampling function to each block, choosing from the pixels within each block the pixel identified by that function, and outputting a sampling signal derived from the selected pixel’s value. The device also includes a reduced-image generation unit that produces a reduced image based on the sampling signal output by the image sensor for each block.
outputs.L3:
The disclosure relates to an imaging apparatus and an associated information processing system designed to reduce the amount of video data transmitted over a network. By decreasing the volume of transmitted data, the system can use network resources more efficiently while also lowering the power consumption of the imaging apparatus.

The imaging apparatus includes an image sensor having a plurality of pixels arranged in vertical and horizontal directions across an imaging surface. A pixel control unit divides this imaging surface into multiple blocks and applies a sampling function to select at least one pixel from each block. Based on the pixel values obtained from the selected pixels, the pixel control unit generates corresponding sampling signals.

A reduced image generating unit then uses these sampling signals to produce a reduced-resolution image. Because the reduced image is generated from only a subset of the pixels on the imaging surface, the apparatus can limit the amount of image data that must be processed and transmitted. This approach helps reduce network traffic and contributes to lower power consumption during image capture, processing, and communication.
outputs.L4:
An imaging apparatus and an associated information processing system are configured to reduce both the volume of image data transmitted over a network and the power consumed during image acquisition and communication. The imaging apparatus includes an image sensor having a plurality of pixels arranged in a two-dimensional array. The pixel array is logically divided into multiple blocks, each containing a predetermined number of pixels. A sampling function selects one or more representative pixels from each block according to a fixed, variable, or dynamically determined sampling pattern.

When an image is captured, the apparatus reads sampling signals from the selected pixels rather than reading and transmitting signals from every pixel in the sensor. A reduced-resolution image is then generated by arranging or processing the sampled signals in accordance with the positions of their corresponding blocks. The resulting image preserves an overall representation of the captured scene while containing substantially fewer pixels than a full-resolution image.

The reduced image may be processed locally or transmitted through a wired or wireless network to an external information processing device, such as a server, computer, monitoring terminal, or cloud-based system. Because the amount of image data is reduced before transmission, the system requires less network bandwidth and can decrease communication latency and storage requirements. In addition, limiting pixel readout and subsequent signal-processing operations reduces the activity of the image sensor, processing circuitry, memory, and communication interface. The block-based sampling technique therefore lowers the imaging apparatus’s overall power consumption while still providing image information suitable for monitoring, analysis, object detection, or other processing tasks.
outputs.L5:
**The Power of “The”**

“The” is one of the smallest yet most important words in the English language. It is a definite article, used when referring to a specific person, place, object, or idea. Although it often goes unnoticed, “the” gives clarity and direction to a sentence. There is a clear difference between saying “a book” and “the book”: the first may mean any book, while the second points to one particular book.

Beyond grammar, “the” helps people create shared meaning. Expressions such as “the sun,” “the future,” and “the truth” suggest something familiar, unique, or universally understood. This simple three-letter word demonstrates how even the smallest elements of language can have a powerful influence on communication.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent abstract for an imaging apparatus that reduces network video data and power consumption by selecting pixels within sensor blocks according to a sampling function and generating a reduced image.
counterfactuals.output: An imaging apparatus includes an image sensor having a pixel array, processing circuitry, and a communication interface. The processing circuitry partitions image data captured by the pixel array into a plurality of sensor blocks and, for each sensor block, selects one or more pixels according to a sampling function. The sampling function may determine selected pixels based on a spatial pattern, image content, operating condition, or combinations thereof. The processing circuitry generates a reduced image from the selected pixels while omitting or suppressing unselected pixel data. The reduced image is provided to the communication interface for transmission over a network. By limiting pixel readout, processing, storage, and transmission to selected pixel data, the imaging apparatus reduces network video data volume and power consumption while retaining image information suitable for monitoring, analysis, or reconstruction.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a formal patent-style summary describing an image sensor partitioned into blocks, a pixel control unit that samples one or more pixels from each block, and a reduced-image generation unit.
counterfactuals.output: An image sensing apparatus includes an image sensor having a plurality of pixels arranged in an imaging region, the imaging region being partitioned into a plurality of blocks. A pixel control unit is configured to select and sample one or more pixels from each of the plurality of blocks according to a predetermined or dynamically determined sampling pattern. A reduced-image generation unit is configured to generate reduced-image data based on pixel signals obtained from the sampled pixels. By acquiring representative pixel information from the respective blocks, the apparatus generates a reduced-resolution image while reducing at least one of readout time, data volume, power consumption, and processing load. In some embodiments, the sampling pattern is adjustable based on imaging conditions, a target reduction ratio, or characteristics of a captured scene.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Convert the following invention concept into patent language: a camera lowers transmission bandwidth and energy use by dividing its pixel array into multiple blocks, selecting pixels in each block using a sampling function, and constructing a downsampled image from the selected pixel values.
counterfactuals.output:
### Exemplary Patent Claim

1. **An imaging apparatus comprising:**
   - a pixel array comprising a plurality of pixels;
   - processing circuitry configured to:
     - partition the pixel array into a plurality of pixel blocks;
     - for each pixel block, select at least one pixel according to a sampling function;
     - obtain pixel values from the selected pixels; and
     - construct a downsampled image using the obtained pixel values; and
   - a communication interface configured to transmit data representing the downsampled image,

   wherein selection of the pixels and construction of the downsampled image reduce at least one of transmission bandwidth or energy consumption relative to transmission of an image comprising pixel values from the entire pixel array.

### Abstract-Style Description

An imaging system and method are disclosed for reducing data-transmission bandwidth and energy consumption. A pixel array of an image sensor is logically or physically divided into a plurality of blocks. One or more pixels within each block are selected according to a sampling function, and pixel values are acquired from the selected pixels. The acquired pixel values are arranged or otherwise processed to construct a downsampled representation of an image captured by the pixel array. The downsampled representation may be transmitted or stored in place of full-resolution image data, thereby reducing the amount of image data generated, processed, or communicated.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe the first aspect of a disclosure concerning an imaging apparatus and information processing system capable of reducing the amount of video data sent over a network while suppressing camera power consumption.
counterfactuals.output: In a first aspect, the disclosure provides an imaging apparatus that operates the camera in a low-power, reduced-transmission mode and changes its imaging or transmission operation when a relevant event or subject is detected. Images are captured and/or sent at a lower rate during ordinary periods, while necessary video is acquired and transmitted at a higher rate when required. An information-processing apparatus on the network can analyze the reduced data and return control information to the camera. This limits network traffic without requiring the camera to perform continuous, power-intensive processing.

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a single-paragraph patent disclosure for a low-power network imaging device whose sensor controller applies a sampling function to each block of a two-dimensional pixel array, outputs corresponding sampling signals, and uses them to create a reduced image.
counterfactuals.output: A low-power network imaging device comprises a two-dimensional pixel array, a sensor controller, an image processor, and a network interface, wherein the sensor controller partitions the pixel array into a plurality of blocks and applies a sampling function to pixel data associated with each block to generate a corresponding sampling signal representative of the block. The sampling function may select one or more pixels, combine pixel values, or compute a statistical value for each block based on a power mode, image content, or network condition. The image processor assembles the sampling signals according to the spatial arrangement of the blocks to create a reduced image having a lower resolution or data volume than an image represented by the full pixel array. The reduced image is provided through the network interface to a remote device, and acquisition, processing, memory access, or transmission of unsampled pixel data may be disabled or reduced, thereby decreasing power consumption and network bandwidth while retaining spatial information for monitoring, detection, or subsequent image-processing operations.
